Recommended workflow
☐ Leadership completes Sections 1–5 (brand, positioning, audiences, sitemap, business goals).
☐ Project team completes Section 7 for every featured project.
☐ Discipline leads complete Expertise and Sector forms.
☐ HR completes People + Careers.
☐ Marketing completes Insights, Awards, Media, Client Proof and SEO.
☐ Admin/legal completes Contact, Policies, Corporate Details and downloadable credentials.
☐ Website developer uses Sections 22–29 as the implementation checklist.
☐ Before launch, run the final content and asset audit in Section 30.
1. BENCHMARK BASIS &amp; WEBSITE DIRECTION
Use HCP as the visual/architectural reference, while adding deeper expertise, sector, research, people, sustainability, client-conversion and cross-linking systems observed on leading global architecture practices.

<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="3ADFE438" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00237C43" w:rsidRPr="002E00B8" w:rsidRDefault="00000000"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidRPr="002E00B8"><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:sz w:val="17"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Ashraya Architects is a multidisciplinary architecture 
and design practice built around the belief that strong design must connect vision with practical delivery. The studio works across architecture, commercial and corporate projects, interior design, urban design and master planning, while supporting projects through design consultancy, tendering and construction documentation, 3D development and architectural visualization, brochure and real-estate design communication, and product/furniture design.
Our process begins with understanding the client, project goals, context, budget, programme and long-term value. Research and design drivers are translated into clear concepts, planning strategies, visualizations and coordinated documentation. We aim to balance human experience, spatial quality, functionality, technical coordination, constructability and commercial considerations rather than treating design as a purely visual exercise.
Ashraya Architects is developing as a corporate, systems-led practice with a strong focus on professional project delivery, transparent communication and long-term industry relationships. Our website and public communication are intended to show not only finished images, but also the thinking, process, collaboration and measurable value behind the work.
From product and interior scale to buildings, commercial developments and urban-scale thinking, the practice seeks to create meaningful, responsible and well-resolved design outcomes—from vision to built reality.

<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="7605813E" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00B44CB4" w:rsidRPr="00B44CB4" w:rsidRDefault="00B44CB4" w:rsidP="00B44CB4"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:sz w:val="17"/><w:lang w:val="en-IN"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidRPr="00B44CB4"><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:sz w:val="17"/><w:lang w:val="en-IN"/></w:rPr><w:t>Our Story
Founded in 2021 by Priyansh 
Barvaliya
 and Meet Lad, Ashraya Architects was born from a shared ambition to create spaces that go beyond function — spaces that carry purpose, identity and lasting value.
The name Ashraya reflects our belief in creating places that offer a sense of shelter, belonging and connection. What began as a focused design practice has steadily evolved into a growing multidisciplinary studio, bringing together architecture, interiors, visualization, planning and project consultancy.
Our journey is driven by curiosity, continuous learning and the desire to challenge conventional ways of thinking. Each project strengthens our understanding of design, technology, execution and collaboration.
Today, we are building Ashraya Architects into a future-ready corporate design practice — structured, multidisciplinary and ambitious, yet deeply rooted in thoughtful design.
One Vision. Multiple Disciplines. Meaningful Impact.
Let’s Design Tomorrow.

<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="113FA002" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00237C43" w:rsidRPr="005160F8" w:rsidRDefault="00000000"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:color w:val="000000" w:themeColor="text1"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidRPr="005160F8"><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:color w:val="000000" w:themeColor="text1"/><w:sz w:val="17"/></w:rPr><w:t>Ashraya Architects is a multidisciplinary architecture and design practice focused on turning ideas into purposeful, coordinated and buildable outcomes. Our work spans architecture, interiors, commercial and corporate projects, urban design, master planning, visualization, tendering and documentation, and related design communication. We combine design thinking with practical project delivery—studying context, people, business goals and technical requirements before shaping the final solution. The studio is being developed as a corporate, systems-led practice with clear processes, collaborative decision-making and long-term client relationships at its core.

<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="0C71E5D8" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00CC2065" w:rsidRDefault="00000000"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="0"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="16"/></w:rPr><w:t>MUST
<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="088B3F20" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00CC2065" w:rsidRDefault="00000000"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="0"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="16"/></w:rPr><w:t>300–800 words.
<w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="2556" w:type="dxa"/><w:tcMar><w:top w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="90" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="110" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar><w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr><w:p w14:paraId="6101762E" w14:textId="77777777" w:rsidR="00E018FB" w:rsidRPr="005160F8" w:rsidRDefault="00E018FB" w:rsidP="00E018FB"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:color w:val="000000" w:themeColor="text1"/><w:sz w:val="17"/><w:lang w:val="en-IN"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidRPr="005160F8"><w:rPr><w:b/><w:bCs/><w:color w:val="000000" w:themeColor="text1"/><w:sz w:val="17"/><w:lang w:val="en-IN"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Ashraya Architects was founded in 2021 by Priyansh 
Barvaliya
 and Meet Lad with a shared ambition to create spaces that are thoughtful, purposeful and meaningful.
From the beginning, the idea was simple but strong: architecture should do more than look good. It should respond to people, place, function and context while creating long-term value. That belief became the foundation of Ashraya.
The name “Ashraya” reflects the idea of shelter, belonging and identity. For us, it represents the relationship between people and the spaces they inhabit. Every project is therefore seen not only as a design opportunity, but as a chance to create a stronger connection between purpose, experience and place.
What began as a focused design practice has steadily evolved into a growing 
multidisciplinary studio. Over time, the practice has expanded its capabilities across architecture, interiors, commercial and corporate projects, residential developments, visualization, planning, technical documentation, tendering and project consultancy.
This evolution has been shaped by curiosity, continuous learning and the willingness to improve with every project.
Each commission has helped us strengthen our understanding of design, technology, materials, execution, coordination and project delivery. As the practice grows, we continue to build stronger systems, deeper technical capability and more collaborative ways of working.
Our approach is rooted in a balance between creative thinking and practical clarity. We believe meaningful design happens when ideas are supported by strong planning, technical understanding, collaboration and disciplined execution.
Today, Ashraya Architects is moving toward a more structured, corporate and multidisciplinary practice. Our focus is increasingly on larger, more complex and diverse projects where design thinking can create measurable value for clients, users and the built environment.
We aim to work with developers, businesses, institutions, entrepreneurs, consultants and industry partners who share an ambition to create better places.
Our long-term vision is to build Ashraya Architects into a strong, trusted and future-ready design practice and brand—one that is recognized not only for the quality of its projects, but also for its thinking, professionalism, 
systems and ability to deliver meaningful outcomes.
We continue to evolve by investing in design excellence, technology, knowledge, collaboration and people.
The journey that began in 2021 is still in its early chapters. What remains constant is the ambition to keep learning, improving and creating work that stays relevant over time.
Let’s Design Tomorrow.

34. CONTENT WRITING RULES FOR THE FINAL WEBSITE
☐ Lead with specific facts and client/design outcomes, not generic adjectives.
☐ Use short paragraphs and strong headings; architecture imagery should have room to breathe.
☐ Explain the “why” behind design decisions, not only the finished form.
☐ Where possible, connect claims to evidence, project outcomes or measurable performance.
☐ Do not overuse words such as iconic, world-class, unique, luxurious, innovative unless evidence supports them.
☐ Write for clients and decision-makers as well as architects.
☐ Keep service pages business-aware; keep project pages design-rich.
☐ Maintain one consistent vocabulary for project status, sector, service and location.
☐ Use active voice and plain professional English.
☐ Every page should have a next step: related project, related insight, contact or application.
35. FINAL NOTES / OPEN DECISIONS
01. RESOLVED / VERIFY: Founded in 2021 by Priyansh Barvaliya and Meet Lad; both are listed as Co-founders &amp; Principal Architects. Professional registrations/credentials still require confirmation.
02. RESOLVED / VERIFY: Head office standardized as A-503, Vivanta Icon, Madhuvan Circle, Pal, Surat, Gujarat, India. Current reach statement: Surat/Gujarat base + wider India; specific expansion cities still to be confirmed.
03. WORKING FIGURES: Team 10–15; completed projects 10–12; ongoing projects 10; combined leadership experience 14 years based on 7 years each. Verify exact current figures before public launch.
04. PROJECTS: Seven launch projects are identified. Add at least one more strong project to meet the recommended 8–15 launch range, and complete all project metadata, stories, media, credits and permissions.
05. SERVICES / SECTORS: Priority sector and service taxonomy has been standardized in this review. Leadership still needs to confirm whether Project/Construction Management and/or turnkey execution is an actual public service.
06. PROOF: Client/logo/testimonial permissions, awards, media features and certifications remain unprovided. Omit these blocks at launch if verified approvals are not available; move them to Phase 2.
07. TECHNOLOGY: Exact software/BIM stack, digital-collaboration platforms, performance tools and any sustainability-certification capability still require confirmation before publication.
08. CONTACT: Confirm central project/general routing email, WhatsApp/phone, vendor/collaboration/media routing owners and the final response SLA.
09. CAREERS: Confirm Interior Designer experience ranges, software requirements by role, portfolio file-size limit, interview stages/response timing and any publishable employee benefits.
10. ASSETS: Link the final logo pack, brand guidelines (if available), project image folders, studio/team photography, leadership portraits and approved archive images.
11. GROWTH TARGETS: Confirm the monthly qualified-enquiry target and any minimum/ideal project scale, budget or fee thresholds that should be used for lead qualification.
12. LEGAL / LANGUAGE: Confirm Privacy Policy, Terms and Cookie requirements with legal advice, and confirm whether Gujarati/Hindi remain Phase 2 or should launch with English.
